title: Morgan says Brown was CIA research
summary: Jan Lundquist tells of Morgan says Brown was CIA research, about 1950s-1970s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Morgan has told Paul that Townsend was basically CIA research.

plain: Jan Lundquist, who appears in a documentary about the inventor Townsend Brown, an American who built devices some say were early flying saucer technology, speaks on podcast host Jesse Michels' show. Lundquist says that a man named Morgan told Paul Schatzkin, a writer who studied Brown's life, that Brown's work was basically CIA research. If true, it would mean the US spy agency was quietly behind Brown's work from the 1950s on.
